name: Original
description: Cloud shoulders, known as "clouds on shoulders", are "advanced customization" unique to the East. The product design is inspired by the Qing Dynasty embroidered butterfly pattern cloud shoulder currently wandering in the UK. Due to its exquisite skills and lifelike embroidery, it is known as the leader in cloud shoulder craftsmanship. Pinku hopes to use metal puzzles to allow players to personally send home the treasures they have wandered in foreign lands.
